what: Consolidated machine-readable verdict for Sprint 7 Rung 2.5 (truncation target isolation). Diagnostic only: no PPO training was run, no reward/actor/GAE/value-clip/horizon/action-space/observation-space/risk-predictor change was made, Rung 3 was NOT launched.

integrity.disclosed_naming_deviation: All new ARTIFACTS and LOGS carry the required SPRINT_7_RUNG2_5_ prefix. The four new SCRIPTS follow the repo's existing _diag_rungN_ convention instead, so they sit next to _diag_rung0.py / _diag_rung1_critic.py.

brief_premise_check.brief_claim: gamma^400 ~ 0.67 implies the target is mostly critic-controlled
brief_premise_check.why: gamma^400 is discount survival, not share of target magnitude; 400 steps of two-sided reward accumulate to mean|.| ~ 6.3 against a bootstrap of ~0.4, so the critic controls ~9.4% at t=0

both.note: true tail is EXACTLY zero, verified by forcing 120 post-terminal steps: sum|reward| = 0.000000. This bootstrap is pure injected bias.

B_truncation_stratification.dominant_finding: SELECTION EFFECT the brief did not anticipate: truncated episodes are the GOOD ones (mean return +7.33) and naturally-terminating episodes are the BAD ones (-10.58), an ~18-unit gap. The truncation bootstrap is therefore applied selectively to high-return episodes, so V(s_T) bias is a non-random perturbation correlated with outcome.
B_truncation_stratification.risk_does_not_drive_truncation: risk means 0.0823 / 0.0853 / 0.0852 across the three classes

C_critic_dependence_feasibility.mechanism: ignore the returned `done` flag; env.py:594 computes done as an advisory flag and step never blocks
C_critic_dependence_feasibility.why_episode_steps_must_not_be_mutated: prog = step_idx / cfg.episode_steps feeds the per-agent observation (env.py:445) and global state (env.py:524); mutating the horizon changes observations and therefore the trajectory
C_critic_dependence_feasibility.determinism: self._rng appears only at env.py:192/219/224 and solely selects the episode start; build_patient_tasks (criticality.py:109) has no RNG; an episode is fully determined by episode_start_tick
verified: an intervening episode does not perturb a replay
honest_limits: the FINAL frozen R2 policy is replayed over the training start distribution; this is NOT a reconstruction of the actual training rollouts (per-episode torch RNG states were never saved)
past step 400 prog > 1.0, so continuation ACTIONS are chosen on out-of-distribution observations; continuation REWARDS are true environment rewards
the per-episode truncation trend over training is NOT recoverable: history.csv has no length column and train.py:271 prints only a single end-of-run aggregate

D_three_targets.key_result: the critic bootstrap is ~1.7x WORSE than ignoring the tail entirely; correlations are near-identical, so the bootstrap adds error without adding rank information

E_sign_test.disclaimer: OFFLINE CAUSAL DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. No PPO training, no actor gradient, no production edit. Every fitted critic is a FRESH module.

truncation_is_policy_dependent.mechanism: the MC target is critic-free only while episodes terminate naturally, and R2's own training moved the policy into the regime where they do not (greedy mean length 367 -> 393). The target's critic-freeness is a property of the POLICY, not of the target, and it self-erodes.

residual_attribution.interpretation: C0's high-risk miscalibration is mostly an UNDER-FITTING / distribution-shift artifact, not a target-formulation artifact. This is a THIRD mechanism, distinct from both the Rung 1 target hypothesis and the actor stall.

validity_limit.what_is_unaffected: arm-vs-arm and raw-vs-paired contrasts (matched rows; agreement/per_action skip ref_action; noise_floor and the paired statistic read baseline GAE positionally)
validity_limit.what_is_provisional: absolute sign-agreement levels and per-action means for R2

r2_native_rows.why: rebuild the deviation set from R2's OWN greedy baselines so ref_action and the legal mask are self-consistent
r2_native_rows.selection_rule: Rung 0's rule verbatim: same 16 start ticks, has_task + >=2-legal filter, pools keyed by the action greedy chose, same risk buckets, caps A=150/B=80/C=60, evenly-spaced np.linspace take (no RNG)
findings: R2's deployed critic is BELOW chance at high risk on its own states (0.4396 team / 0.4597 own) with NEGATIVE high-risk Spearman (-0.104); the D1-row estimate (0.5285/0.5627) was FLATTERING R2
sign fidelity degrades monotonically with risk: 0.5155 (lo) -> 0.4667 (mid) -> 0.4396 (hi)

ground truth is unambiguous and significant under BOTH attributions: at high risk migrating is strongly better than staying (own: STAY -0.8822 t=-3.99 vs EDGE +0.8675 t=+3.71), independently confirming the Sprint 7 premise that the risk signal is real and large
C0 understates EDGE's true value by ~10x (+0.1655 estimated vs +1.6227 true)
MIGRATE_TO_CLOUD is significantly inverted: true +5.2115 (t=+8.69) vs gae -5.4068 (t=-3.19); n=6 so suggestive only. The critic is MOST wrong about the action that is MOST valuable.
the noise-floor offset is large, risk-dependent, and CHANGES SIGN across buckets (+2.40 at mid vs -0.87 at hi), so it cannot be absorbed as a constant baseline

E_sign_test.central_finding: The advantage-sign information is already present in R2's deployed critic; it is buried under a per-state offset error in V(s). The truncation-target choice moves sign agreement by <= 0.4pp; differencing away the offset moves it by +27 to +49pp -- a ~100x larger effect. PPO's surrogate multiplies log pi(a|s) by the RAW advantage, so it inherits the full offset error rather than the clean paired signal.

retraction.claim: E.4 (Rung 0 rows): R2's deployed critic assigns high-risk EDGE a significantly negative advantage (-1.1089, t = -2.95), a confirmed sign inversion
retraction.why: Rung 0's D1 rows force an action R2's mask marks illegal in 53% of cases; that contamination pushed C0's EDGE estimate down. On R2-native rows C0 gives high-risk EDGE +0.1655 (t=+0.51) -- correctly signed and correctly ranked above STAY.
retraction.what_survives: below-chance high-risk sign agreement, negative high-risk Spearman, a ~10x understatement of EDGE, and a significant inversion on MIGRATE_TO_CLOUD

G_actor_stall.minibatch_tail_quirk_note: T = 8*400 = 3200 is divisible by 4, so exactly 16 minibatches occurred; the quirk was neither triggered nor fixed

ppo_ratio_range.conclusion: clip_frac = 0 is the arithmetically inevitable consequence of a ratio pinned at 1; k3 = (r-1) - log r is second-order in (r-1), hence ~1e-8

corrections_to_my_rung2_report: clip_frac first touches 0 at update 36, is nonzero again through update 61, and is permanently 0 only from update 62 -- NOT '~update 50'. 22 of 75 updates are exactly zero.
clip_frac -> 0 is NOT an R2 anomaly. A0 does the same thing (12/75 zero updates, last nonzero at 68). It is normal behaviour for this setup at convergence and is NOT the discriminating signal.
adv_std stays in 2.47-3.93 across all 75 R2 updates -- the advantage signal never vanished.

softmax_saturation.verdict: A0 is the decisive control: 0.0000 of A0's entries exceed max-prob 0.99 against 50.5% of R2's. The collapse is SPECIFIC TO R2 -- not a property of the architecture, the task, or the entropy coefficient (identical at 0.02 in both).
softmax_saturation.entropy_bonus_cannot_reverse_it: the entropy-only gradient is 4.79e-03, just 7.8% of R2's total actor gradient, already including entropy_coef = 0.02

R2.note: decays monotonically to 9.95% of ln4 = 1.3863 and is still sagging at the end

G_actor_stall.diagnosis: neither normal convergence nor insufficient gradient signal: POLICY COLLAPSE VIA SOFTMAX SATURATION, specific to R2

highrisk_sparsity_hypothesis.why: every minibatch contains 57-79 high-risk decision entries; only 1 of 16 lacks a high-risk EDGE entry. The '37 -> 8 usable high-risk EDGE samples and 30% zero-high-risk minibatch rate' figures DO NOT REPRODUCE. A0 -- which did not collapse -- had a comparable 3.5 per minibatch.

unresolved_discrepancy.rung2_headline: high-risk EDGE share 2.7% -> 8.1% (A0 -> R2) at risk > 0.6, greedy
unresolved_discrepancy.rung2_5_saturation_census: at risk > 0.50 over 8 stochastic episodes: R2 3.7% (10/269), A0 6.6% (14/212) -- R2 WORSE, opposite direction
unresolved_discrepancy.rung2_5_stratification: R2 high-risk EDGE share by end-class 0.1014 / 0.0542 / 0.0724 over 200 episodes, spanning both figures
differences: very small counts (10 and 14 EDGE events)
unresolved_discrepancy.status: UNRESOLVED. I cannot currently reproduce Rung 2's direction of change and am not selecting the flattering measurement. Treat 'R2 migrates more at high risk' as unresolved.

old_replica_defects_found.what: hardcodes agent.compute_gae(buf), so the critic is regressed on the LAMBDA-return even when the checkpoint was trained with critic_target='mc'
old_replica_defects_found.consequence: the known cause of the D4 replica failure

old_replica_defects_found.what: calls buf.set_bootstrap(buf.ptr - 1, boot) with no `truncated` argument, which now defaults to True, flagging EVERY replica episode as a time-limit truncation
old_replica_defects_found.consequence: harmless for compute_gae (ignores the flag) but systematically wrong for compute_mc_returns (reads it)

H_replica_fix.fix: a NEW R2-aware replica was written; _diag_rung0.py was deliberately left untouched so Rung 0's artifacts remain reproducible
H_replica_fix.independent_confirmation_of_freeze: with the correct MC target, R2's actor still shows k1 = 6.98e-06, k3 = 8.67e-08, clip_frac = 0.000000, actor loss 9.81e-05, param delta L2 5.43e-03. The R2 actor really did stop making meaningful policy updates, and this no longer depends on the stale lambda-target replica.

q1_how_much_of_r2_target_was_critic_depe.answer: far less than the brief assumed

q2_does_continuation_mc_materially_chang.note: reward-only with NO bootstrap at all is CLOSER to the ideal (0.046) than R2's actual target. It DID matter enormously for A0 (0.584) -- but that gap is already closed.

q3_does_it_materially_improve_highrisk_s.note: the paired estimator lifts every arm identically -- a ~100x larger effect than the target choice

q4_is_rung1_hypothesis_still_supported.answer: PARTLY -- and it is no longer the leading explanation
supported: the self-referential lambda-target genuinely wrecked A0's critic (explained 9.4% of the true boundary tail, inflated it ~16x, contaminated the target by 58.4% of SD)

R2's critic still gets the high-risk ranking wrong on its OWN states: below-chance sign agreement (0.4396 team / 0.4597 own), negative high-risk Spearman (-0.104), a ~10x understatement of EDGE's true value, and a significant inversion on MIGRATE_TO_CLOUD (n=6, suggestive only)
the ground-truth risk signal is real and large under both attributions -- the Sprint 7 premise holds
not_supported: fixing the REMAINING target dependence does not fix the advantage sign (<= 3.5pp, at chance)
84.5% of the achievable high-risk calibration gain comes from merely refitting the critic to convergence on R2's OWN target; only 15.5% from changing the target
the strongest single piece of Rung-1-style evidence I had reported (E.4's 'significantly inverted EDGE, t = -2.95') was RETRACTED once measured on self-consistent rows
q4_is_rung1_hypothesis_still_supported.independent: the actor stalled by softmax saturation (50.5% of entries at max-prob > 0.99 vs A0's 0.0000), which no target change addresses

q5_is_a_clean_online_rung3_justified.go_no_go_rule: Launch an online Rung 3 whose PRIMARY intervention is the truncation target ONLY IF the offline diagnostic shows continuation-MC improving high-risk sign agreement by >= 5 percentage points over R2's deployed critic under BOTH attributions, OR reducing MAD-to-ideal by >= 25% of target SD.
redirect_priority: actor-side plasticity: R2's entropy collapsed to 9.95% of ln 4 with half A0's gradient magnitude, while A0 under an identical entropy_coef never saturated at all

critic value-level calibration: the per-state offset that pairing removes (+27 to +49pp of sign agreement), and the 84.5% of high-risk calibration recoverable by fitting to convergence rather than by changing the target
q5_is_a_clean_online_rung3_justified.scope_note: designing that intervention is OUT OF SCOPE for this rung

three_separated_mechanisms.status: REAL and SEVERE for A0; LARGELY ALREADY FIXED by R2 (87% of the gap closed); remaining headroom 3-8% of target SD

three_separated_mechanisms.name: per-state critic value calibration / under-fitting under distribution shift
three_separated_mechanisms.status: NEW, and the largest recoverable term: 84.5% of high-risk residual comes from refitting alone, and pairing away the per-state offset recovers +27 to +49pp of sign agreement

three_separated_mechanisms.name: actor-side softmax saturation / policy collapse
three_separated_mechanisms.status: NEW, SPECIFIC TO R2, independent of the critic target: 50.5% of decision entries at max-prob > 0.99 vs A0's 0.0000

superseded_claims_in_earlier_rung2_5_art.text_asserts: Rung 0's deviation pairs contain ZERO truncated episodes, so the three targets are identical on them
superseded_claims_in_earlier_rung2_5_art.status: FALSE for R2 -- 10 of 16 R2 greedy baselines truncate. It was written assuming A0's 0/16 profile (Rung 1 ran on A0). invalid_comparisons_flagged: explained_var in *_updates.csv is TARGET-RELATIVE (each run's EV is measured against its OWN critic target), so A0's final 0.8229 vs R2's 0.7409 is apples-to-oranges and must NOT be used as evidence that R2's critic is worse
